title: 時間投影室偵測器~Time-projection-chamber detectors
focus: 氣體漂移、GEM 增益、空間電荷校正與連續讀出的 TPC 工程~Gas drift, GEM gain, space-charge calibration and continuous readout for TPC engineering
summary: 以 CERN ALICE 的 90 m³ 時間投影室為範本：從 400 V/cm 下的電子漂移與擴散，到四層 GEM 讀出的增益與離子回流，再把雷射、氪校正、空間電荷畸變圖與 524,160 通道的連續讀出整合成可交接的偵測器效能紀錄。~Using the 90 m³ ALICE TPC at CERN as the template: from electron drift and diffusion at 400 V/cm, through gain and ion back-flow of four-GEM readout, to laser and krypton calibration, space-charge distortion maps and continuous readout of 524,160 channels, integrated into a transferable detector performance record.

units.anchor: 中央電極與漂移體積~Central electrode and drift volume
units.title: 游離、漂移與時間投影原理~Ionisation, drift and the time-projection principle
units.mechanism: 帶電粒子穿過氣體時沿軌跡產生初級游離電子團。ALICE TPC 把中央電極保持在 −100 kV，兩端的讀出平面接近地電位，形成 400 V/cm 的軸向電場，電子以 2.58 cm/µs 的速度向端板漂移；墊片的二維位置給出 x、y，到達時間乘以漂移速度給出 z，三維軌跡因此由「把時間投影成空間」重建。Ne-CO₂-N₂（90-10-5）混合氣兼顧低原子序（多重散射小）、足夠的初級游離密度與較低的離子回流。~A charged particle crossing the gas leaves clusters of primary ionisation along its path. The ALICE TPC holds its central electrode at −100 kV with the two end-plate readout planes near ground, creating a 400 V/cm axial field along which electrons drift at 2.58 cm/µs; the two-dimensional pad position gives x and y, and arrival time multiplied by drift velocity gives z, so the three-dimensional track is reconstructed by projecting time into space. The Ne-CO₂-N₂ (90-10-5) mixture balances low atomic number for little multiple scattering, adequate primary ionisation density and low ion back-flow.
units.model: E = V/L = 100 kV/250 cm = 400 V/cm；最長漂移時間 t_max = L/v_d = 250 cm ÷ 2.58 cm/µs ≈ 97 µs；取 W ≈ 38 eV、最小游離能損約 1.5 keV/cm，每公分約產生 40 個電子，一列 7.5 mm 的墊片約收集 30 個初級電子。~E = V/L = 100 kV/250 cm = 400 V/cm; the longest drift time is t_max = L/v_d = 250 cm ÷ 2.58 cm/µs ≈ 97 µs; with W ≈ 38 eV and a minimum-ionising loss of about 1.5 keV/cm the gas yields roughly 40 electrons per cm, so a 7.5 mm pad row collects about 30 primary electrons.
units.verify: 由中央電極電壓與漂移長度算出場強與 t_max，再與雷射軌跡或宇宙射線事件中觀察到的最大到達時間比較（5 MHz 取樣下約 485 個時間格）；z 座標的線性以位置已知的雷射束驗證。~Compute the field and t_max from the electrode voltage and drift length, then compare with the latest arrival times seen in laser or cosmic-ray events (about 485 time bins at 5 MHz sampling); check z linearity with laser beams at known positions.
units.failure: 若假設的漂移速度錯 1%，全長漂移的 z 座標偏 2.5 cm，TPC 兩半的軌跡在中央電極處無法對接，頂點與動量重建都失真。~A 1% error in the assumed drift velocity displaces full-drift z by 2.5 cm, so tracks from the two TPC halves fail to match at the central electrode and both vertex and momentum reconstruction degrade.
units.misconception: 電子沿電場一路加速到很高速度，所以漂移時間可以忽略。~Electrons accelerate along the field to very high speed, so drift time can be ignored.

units.anchor: 擴散與磁場~Diffusion and magnetic field
units.title: 擴散、磁場與位置解析度極限~Diffusion, magnetic field and the resolution limit
units.mechanism: 漂移中的電子不斷與氣體分子碰撞，電子雲以隨機走動方式散開，橫向與縱向寬度都隨漂移時間按 √(2Dt) 成長，工程上常寫成 σ = D'·√L，D' 的單位是 µm/√cm。ALICE 的 0.5 T 螺線管磁場讓電子在兩次碰撞之間繞磁力線迴旋，橫向擴散按 1/√(1+ω²τ²) 縮小，縱向擴散則不受影響。擴散決定電子團抵達讀出面時的尺寸，再除以電子數的平方根才是重心定位的統計極限。~A drifting electron collides continuously with gas molecules, so the electron cloud spreads as a random walk whose transverse and longitudinal widths grow as √(2Dt), usually written σ = D'·√L with D' in µm/√cm. The 0.5 T solenoid field of ALICE makes electrons gyrate between collisions, shrinking transverse diffusion by 1/√(1+ω²τ²) while leaving longitudinal diffusion unchanged. Diffusion fixes the size of the cloud reaching the pad plane, and dividing that width by the square root of the electron count gives the statistical limit of centroid positioning.
units.model: 取 D'_T = D'_L = 220 µm/√cm（教學假設），全長 250 cm 漂移後 σ_T = 220×√250 ≈ 3.5 mm；改寫成 σ² = 2Dt，D = (0.348 cm)²/(2×96.9 µs) ≈ 620 cm²/s；縱向的 3.5 mm 對應時間展寬 3.5 mm ÷ 25.8 mm/µs ≈ 135 ns；30 個電子的重心極限約 3.5 mm/√30 ≈ 0.64 mm。~With D'_T = D'_L = 220 µm/√cm (teaching assumption), a full 250 cm drift gives σ_T = 220×√250 ≈ 3.5 mm; in the form σ² = 2Dt this is D = (0.348 cm)²/(2×96.9 µs) ≈ 620 cm²/s; the longitudinal 3.5 mm corresponds to a time spread of 3.5 mm ÷ 25.8 mm/µs ≈ 135 ns, and the centroid limit for 30 electrons is about 3.5 mm/√30 ≈ 0.64 mm.
units.verify: 用雷射軌跡或宇宙射線量電子團在墊片方向與時間方向的寬度隨漂移長度的變化，擬合 σ² = σ₀² + D'²·L 取得 D'，並與 Magboltz 類模擬值比較；再比對磁場開啟與關閉時橫向寬度的差異。~Measure cluster width along pads and along time as a function of drift length with laser or cosmic tracks, fit σ² = σ₀² + D'²·L to extract D' and compare with Magboltz-type simulation; then compare transverse widths with the magnet on and off.
units.failure: 水氣或氧污染改變電子的碰撞特性，擴散係數與漂移速度一起漂移，電子團變寬、信號變矮，遠端漂移叢集的位置解析度與 dE/dx 同時變差。~Water or oxygen contamination alters electron collision properties, so diffusion and drift velocity shift together; clusters broaden and signals shrink, degrading both position resolution and dE/dx for long-drift clusters.
units.misconception: 磁場會同時壓低橫向與縱向擴散。~The magnetic field suppresses both transverse and longitudinal diffusion.

units.anchor: 場籠與電阻鏈~Field cage and resistor chain
units.title: 場籠、高壓與氣體純度~Field cage, high voltage and gas purity
units.mechanism: 場籠用鍍鋁 Mylar 條帶環繞漂移體積，由電阻鏈把 −100 kV 逐級分壓，讓每一條帶的電位落在理想的線性分佈上，電場才能在 2.5 m 的全長保持均勻；靠近讀出面另有裙狀電極修正端部場。氣體系統以閉迴路循環並連續純化，氧與水必須壓在 ppm 等級，否則電子被電負性分子吸附而消失，而且漂移速度會隨 E/N、溫度與壓力改變。~The field cage surrounds the drift volume with aluminised Mylar strips whose potentials are set by a resistor chain dividing the −100 kV step by step, so that every strip sits on the ideal linear potential and the field stays uniform over the 2.5 m drift; skirt electrodes near the readout plane correct the end field. The gas system runs as a closed, continuously purified loop with oxygen and water held at ppm level, because electrons attach to electronegative molecules and vanish, and drift velocity shifts with E/N, temperature and pressure.
units.model: 以 165 條帶、15 mm 間距（教學值）估算：每級電壓 100 kV/165 ≈ 606 V，正是 400 V/cm × 1.5 cm；若電阻鏈總阻值 4.1 GΩ，鏈電流 I ≈ 24 µA、功耗 2.4 W；單一電阻 1% 的誤差讓該級多出約 6 V，在一個間距內形成 1% 的局部場畸變。~Taking 165 strips at 15 mm pitch (teaching values): each step is 100 kV/165 ≈ 606 V, exactly 400 V/cm × 1.5 cm; with a total chain resistance of 4.1 GΩ the chain current is I ≈ 24 µA and the dissipation 2.4 W; a 1% error in one resistor adds about 6 V to that step, a 1% local field distortion over one pitch.
units.verify: 量測各分壓節點電位（或電阻鏈各段阻值）並與線性目標比較；以氧分析儀與露點計監測 O₂ 與 H₂O，用 Goofie 型漂移速度監測器連續記錄 v_d；最後用雷射直線軌跡的殘差檢查場均勻性與 E×B 畸變。~Measure every divider node (or each chain segment) against the linear target; monitor O₂ and H₂O with an oxygen analyser and a dew-point meter, record v_d continuously with a Goofie-type drift-velocity monitor, and finally check field uniformity and E×B distortion from residuals of straight laser tracks.
units.failure: 場籠內一次微放電或一顆漂移的電阻會使局部電位偏離，該區的電子被徑向推移，軌跡出現系統性的弓形殘差；若洩漏讓氧升到數十 ppm，遠端漂移的信號明顯衰減。~A micro-discharge or a drifting resistor shifts the local potential, electrons there are pushed radially and tracks show systematic bow-shaped residuals; a leak raising oxygen to tens of ppm visibly attenuates long-drift signals.
units.misconception: 只要中央電極電壓正確，漂移電場就自動均勻。~If the central-electrode voltage is right, the drift field is automatically uniform.

units.anchor: 四層 GEM 讀出室~Four-GEM readout chambers
units.title: GEM 氣體增益與離子回流~GEM gas gain and ion back-flow
units.mechanism: 讀出室把漂移來的電子送進 50 µm 厚、佈滿 70 µm 微孔的 GEM 箔，孔內數十 kV/cm 的場讓電子雪崩倍增。ALICE 在 Run 3 把每個讀出室做成四層 GEM 疊（標準孔距與大孔距交替），總增益約 2000，同時把離子回流壓到 1% 以下，取代了需要閘極柵而產生死時間的多絲正比室，才能在 50 kHz 的鉛鉛碰撞率下連續讀出。雪崩的統計漲落與第一層 GEM 的電子收集效率共同決定能量解析度。~The readout chambers feed drifted electrons into 50 µm thick GEM foils pierced with 70 µm holes, where fields of tens of kV/cm drive avalanche multiplication. For Run 3 ALICE built each chamber as a four-GEM stack alternating standard and large-pitch foils, giving a total gain of about 2000 while holding ion back-flow below 1%; this replaced the multiwire chambers whose gating grid created dead time, and allows continuous readout at the 50 kHz Pb–Pb collision rate. Avalanche statistics together with electron collection efficiency in the first GEM set the energy resolution.
units.model: 回流離子數 = G×IBF = 2000×0.007 = 14 個離子／初級電子；理想能量解析度 σ_E/E = √((F+b)/N)，取 F = 0.2、b = 0.6、N = 5.9 keV/38 eV ≈ 155，得約 7%；實測約 12% 代表有效電子數只剩 0.8/0.12² ≈ 56 個，即第一層 GEM 的有效透過率約 36%。~Back-flowing ions = G×IBF = 2000×0.007 = 14 ions per primary electron; the ideal energy resolution σ_E/E = √((F+b)/N) with F = 0.2, b = 0.6 and N = 5.9 keV/38 eV ≈ 155 is about 7%; a measured 12% implies only 0.8/0.12² ≈ 56 effective electrons, i.e. an effective transparency of about 36% in the first GEM.
units.verify: 用 ⁵⁵Fe 的 5.9 keV X 光量每個讀出室的增益與能量解析度；以保護電極上陰極電流對陽極電流的比值量離子回流；掃描各層 GEM 電壓畫出增益對 IBF 的折衷曲線，並以長期測試確認工作點的放電率可接受。~Measure gain and energy resolution per chamber with 5.9 keV ⁵⁵Fe X-rays; measure ion back-flow as the ratio of cathode to anode current on the protection electrodes; scan the individual GEM voltages to map the gain-versus-IBF trade-off, and confirm in long-term tests that the discharge rate at the chosen working point is acceptable.
units.failure: 為了改善能量解析度而調高第一層 GEM 電壓，離子回流隨之上升，高碰撞率下空間電荷畸變失控；反之壓得太低則透過率下降、dE/dx 解析度變差。~Raising the first-GEM voltage to improve energy resolution raises ion back-flow and lets space-charge distortion run away at high rate; pushing it too low cuts transparency and worsens dE/dx resolution.
units.misconception: 氣體增益越高，TPC 的軌跡與能損量測一定越好。~Higher gas gain always gives better tracking and energy-loss measurement.

units.anchor: 雷射校正與畸變圖~Laser calibration and distortion maps
units.title: 漂移速度、空間電荷與畸變校正~Drift velocity, space charge and distortion calibration
units.mechanism: 要把到達時間換成 z，必須隨時掌握漂移速度；ALICE 用 266 nm 脈衝雷射經鏡組在腔內產生 336 條直線軌跡，並以獨立的漂移速度監測器追蹤氣體狀態。高碰撞率下回流的離子以約 1.6 cm/ms 緩慢漂移，在腔內累積成空間電荷，其徑向電場把漂移電子推離真實位置；畸變與離子密度成正比，必須用軌跡殘差或電流讀出建立隨時間更新的畸變圖加以修正。~Converting arrival time into z needs the drift velocity at all times; ALICE fires a pulsed 266 nm laser through mirror bundles to create 336 straight tracks inside the volume and follows gas condition with a separate drift-velocity monitor. At high rate the back-flowing ions drift slowly at about 1.6 cm/ms and accumulate as space charge whose radial field pushes drifting electrons off their true positions; the distortion scales with ion density and must be corrected with time-dependent maps built from track residuals or current readout.
units.model: 離子穿越時間 250 cm ÷ 1.6 cm/ms ≈ 160 ms，50 kHz 鉛鉛碰撞下腔內同時存有約 8000 個事件的離子。取均勻離子密度 ρ = 2×10⁴ cm⁻³（教學假設）、半徑 1 m：E_r = ρe·r/(2ε₀) = 3.2×10⁻⁹ C/m³ × 1 m ÷ (2×8.85×10⁻¹² F/m) ≈ 180 V/m = 1.8 V/cm，E_r/E_z = 0.45%，全長漂移的徑向位移 ≈ 250 cm × 0.0045 ≈ 1.1 cm。~Ion transit time is 250 cm ÷ 1.6 cm/ms ≈ 160 ms, so at 50 kHz Pb–Pb the ions of about 8000 events coexist in the volume. For a uniform ion density ρ = 2×10⁴ cm⁻³ (teaching assumption) at radius 1 m, E_r = ρe·r/(2ε₀) = 3.2×10⁻⁹ C/m³ × 1 m ÷ (2×8.85×10⁻¹² F/m) ≈ 180 V/m = 1.8 V/cm, E_r/E_z = 0.45%, and a full-drift electron is displaced radially by ≈ 250 cm × 0.0045 ≈ 1.1 cm.
units.verify: 對幾何已知的雷射軌跡擬合直線並取殘差，分離漂移速度誤差（z 的線性縮放）與空間電荷畸變（隨 r、z 變化的徑向殘差）；把內層矽追蹤器外推的軌跡與 TPC 叢集比較，更新畸變圖，確認修正後殘差回到 1 mm 以下。~Fit straight lines to laser tracks of known geometry and take residuals, separating drift-velocity error (a linear z scaling) from space-charge distortion (radial residuals varying with r and z); compare clusters with tracks extrapolated from the inner silicon tracker, update the distortion map and confirm that corrected residuals return below 1 mm.
units.failure: 若畸變圖更新慢於碰撞率的變化（例如束流強度在幾分鐘內下降），修正會過量或不足，表現為隨時間漂移的動量尺度與頂點偏移。~If distortion maps update more slowly than the collision rate changes, for instance when beam intensity drops within minutes, the correction over- or under-shoots and appears as a time-dependent momentum scale and vertex offset.
units.misconception: 漂移速度在試運轉時量一次就夠用了。~Measuring the drift velocity once at commissioning is enough.

units.anchor: 氪增益圖與 dE/dx~Krypton gain map and dE/dx
units.title: 增益均勻性、dE/dx 與粒子鑑別~Gain uniformity, dE/dx and particle identification
units.mechanism: TPC 的第二項任務是用沿軌跡的能損 dE/dx 鑑別粒子：每一列墊片各量一次叢集電荷，152 列以截斷平均合併以壓制 Landau 分佈的長尾，再與 Bethe–Bloch 曲線比對。前提是每一塊墊片的增益都已知：ALICE 把放射性 ⁸³ᵐKr 注入氣體，其 41.6 keV 的衰變在整個腔內均勻發生，每塊墊片上的峰值位置就是該墊片的增益刻度。dE/dx 解析度由樣本數、樣本長度、增益校正品質與擴散共同決定。~The second job of a TPC is particle identification from energy loss along the track: each pad row measures one cluster charge, the 152 rows are combined as a truncated mean to suppress the Landau tail, and the result is compared with Bethe–Bloch curves. This requires the gain of every pad to be known: ALICE injects radioactive ⁸³ᵐKr into the gas, its 41.6 keV decays occur uniformly throughout the volume, and the peak position on each pad is that pad's gain scale. The dE/dx resolution then depends on sample count, sample length, gain-calibration quality and diffusion.
units.model: 一次 ⁸³ᵐKr 衰變產生 N = 41,600 eV/38 eV ≈ 1095 個初級電子，增益 2000 後約 2.2×10⁶ 個電子 ≈ 0.35 pC；若單一墊片的增益刻度不確定度為 2%，對 152 列截斷平均的貢獻只有 2%/√152 ≈ 0.16%，遠低於 5–6% 的總 dE/dx 解析度，但整列或整區的共同偏差不會被平均掉。~One ⁸³ᵐKr decay yields N = 41,600 eV/38 eV ≈ 1095 primary electrons, about 2.2×10⁶ electrons ≈ 0.35 pC after a gain of 2000; a 2% uncertainty in a single pad's gain contributes only 2%/√152 ≈ 0.16% to a 152-row truncated mean, far below the 5–6% total dE/dx resolution, whereas a common offset of a whole row or region is not averaged away.
units.verify: 逐墊片擬合 Kr 峰建立增益圖，檢查其空間均勻性與隨時間的穩定度；用宇宙射線或低動量的質子、π、電子樣本擬合 Bethe–Bloch 參數，計算各動量區間的解析度與分離能力（以 σ 為單位的峰距）。~Fit the Kr peak pad by pad to build the gain map and check its spatial uniformity and time stability; fit Bethe–Bloch parameters to dE/dx distributions of cosmic rays or low-momentum proton, pion and electron samples, and compute resolution and separation power (peak distance in units of σ) per momentum bin.
units.failure: 增益隨大氣壓每天漂移 1–2% 卻沒有參考信號追蹤時，整條 dE/dx 曲線上下移動，鑑別帶互相滲入，電子與 π 的誤判率上升。~When gain drifts 1–2% per day with air pressure and no reference tracks it, the whole dE/dx curve shifts, identification bands leak into each other and electron–pion misidentification rises.
units.misconception: 對所有列直接取平均就能得到最好的 dE/dx 解析度。~A plain average over all rows gives the best dE/dx resolution.

units.anchor: SAMPA 前端與讀出鏈~SAMPA front end and readout chain
units.title: 前端電子、連續讀出與資料流~Front-end electronics, continuous readout and data flow
units.mechanism: 每塊墊片接到 SAMPA ASIC 的一個電荷靈敏前置放大與整形通道（每顆 32 通道、10 位元 ADC、5 MHz 取樣），約 160 ns 的整形時間與縱向擴散造成的 135 ns 時間展寬相稱。524,160 個通道把數位化波形經光纖連續送出，沒有觸發也沒有死時間，再由 FPGA 讀出卡扣除共模雜訊並做零抑制，才把資料率壓到可儲存的範圍。前端的雜訊、基線穩定度與通道間串音直接決定叢集電荷與位置的品質。~Every pad feeds one charge-sensitive preamplifier–shaper channel of the SAMPA ASIC (32 channels per chip, 10-bit ADC, 5 MHz sampling), whose shaping time of about 160 ns matches the 135 ns time spread from longitudinal diffusion. The 524,160 channels stream digitised waveforms continuously over optical links, with no trigger and no dead time, and FPGA readout cards subtract common-mode noise and apply zero suppression to bring the data rate into a storable range. Front-end noise, baseline stability and channel-to-channel cross-talk directly set cluster-charge and position quality.
units.model: 原始資料率 = 524,160 通道 × 5×10⁶ 樣本/s × 10 bit ≈ 2.62×10¹³ bit/s ≈ 3.28 TB/s，與 ALICE 公布的數值一致；每列墊片約 30 個初級電子 × 增益 2000 = 6×10⁴ 個電子（9.6 fC），若前端等效雜訊電荷 ENC ≈ 670 個電子，單列訊噪比約 90。~Raw data rate = 524,160 channels × 5×10⁶ samples/s × 10 bit ≈ 2.62×10¹³ bit/s ≈ 3.28 TB/s, matching the figure ALICE publishes; a pad row with about 30 primary electrons × gain 2000 gives 6×10⁴ electrons (9.6 fC), and with a front-end equivalent noise charge ENC ≈ 670 electrons the per-row signal-to-noise ratio is about 90.
units.verify: 以內建的脈衝注入電容校正每通道的增益與基線，量 ENC（基線 RMS 換算成電子數）與通道間串音；無束流時記錄基線的共模成分並驗證扣除演算法；用光纖誤碼率與緩衝區佔用率確認讀出鏈在 50 kHz 碰撞率下不丟資料。~Calibrate gain and baseline per channel with the built-in pulse-injection capacitor, measure ENC (baseline RMS converted to electrons) and cross-talk; record common-mode baseline components without beam and validate the subtraction algorithm; confirm with link error rates and buffer occupancy that the readout chain drops no data at 50 kHz.
units.failure: 共模雜訊未扣除時，低電荷叢集被零抑制門檻吃掉，軌跡在遠端漂移處出現斷點；整形時間過短則彈道虧損讓電荷被低估，dE/dx 系統性偏低。~Unsubtracted common-mode noise pushes low-charge clusters under the zero-suppression threshold so tracks break at long drift; too short a shaping time causes ballistic deficit, underestimating charge and biasing dE/dx low.
units.misconception: 連續讀出沒有觸發，所以不需要時間校正。~Continuous readout has no trigger, so no timing calibration is needed.

units.anchor: 試運轉與校正資料庫~Commissioning and calibration database
units.title: 試運轉、效能驗證與交接~Commissioning, performance validation and handoff
units.mechanism: 整機驗證從高壓訓練與氣密測試開始，接著用宇宙射線與雷射確認每個讀出室的效率與對準，再以 Kr 校正建立增益圖，最後在束流下量位置解析度、dE/dx 解析度與動量解析度，並把漂移速度、增益、畸變圖與對準參數連同版本號寫入校正資料庫。交接文件必須記錄工作點（各層 GEM 電壓、增益、IBF）、放電與高壓跳脫的統計，以及每一項效能指標的量測條件。~System validation starts with high-voltage training and gas-tightness tests, continues with cosmic rays and lasers to confirm efficiency and alignment of every readout chamber, then builds the gain map with Kr calibration, and finally measures position, dE/dx and momentum resolution with beam, writing drift velocity, gain, distortion maps and alignment constants with version numbers into the calibration database. The handoff record must document the working point (GEM voltages, gain, IBF), discharge and HV-trip statistics, and the measurement conditions of every performance figure.
units.model: Gluckstern 估計 σ_pT/pT ≈ σ_rφ·pT/(0.3·B·L²)·√(720/(N+4))：取 σ_rφ = 0.8 mm、B = 0.5 T、L = 1.6 m、N = 152、pT = 10 GeV/c，得 0.0008×10/(0.3×0.5×2.56) × √(720/156) ≈ 0.0208×2.15 ≈ 4.5%，這就是單獨 TPC 在高動量區的解析度量級。~Gluckstern estimate σ_pT/pT ≈ σ_rφ·pT/(0.3·B·L²)·√(720/(N+4)): with σ_rφ = 0.8 mm, B = 0.5 T, L = 1.6 m, N = 152 and pT = 10 GeV/c this is 0.0008×10/(0.3×0.5×2.56) × √(720/156) ≈ 0.0208×2.15 ≈ 4.5%, the order of the stand-alone TPC resolution at high momentum.
units.verify: 把宇宙射線軌跡切成上下兩半分別擬合，在交會處比較動量與位置差異以直接量解析度；用 K⁰ₛ 與 Λ 的不變質量寬度驗證動量尺度與解析度；核對校正資料庫中每個參數的生效區間與來源。~Split cosmic-ray tracks into upper and lower halves, fit each separately and compare momentum and position at the crossing point to measure resolution directly; verify momentum scale and resolution from the invariant-mass widths of K⁰ₛ and Λ; check validity intervals and provenance of every parameter in the calibration database.
units.failure: 交接時沒有記錄校正常數的版本，之後的重建會混用不同時期的增益或畸變圖，重新處理的資料出現無法解釋的效能跳變。~If calibration-constant versions are not recorded at handoff, later reconstruction mixes gain or distortion maps from different periods and reprocessed data show unexplained performance jumps.
units.misconception: 每個讀出室在實驗室各自測試合格，整個 TPC 就不需要整機驗證。~If each readout chamber passes lab tests, the whole TPC needs no system validation.

example: 漂移與定位練習：假設 ALICE TPC 以 400 V/cm、v_d = 2.58 cm/µs 運作，一條軌跡在距讀出面 200 cm 處產生叢集。到達時間 t = 200/2.58 ≈ 77.5 µs，以 5 MHz 取樣為 388 個時間格。取 D'_T = 220 µm/√cm，橫向擴散 σ_T = 220×√200 ≈ 3.1 mm；一列 7.5 mm 墊片約收集 30 個初級電子，重心的統計極限為 3.1/√30 ≈ 0.57 mm，再與墊片響應加雜訊項（假設 0.5 mm）平方相加得約 0.76 mm，接近實測的 0.8 mm 等級。若氣體溫度上升讓漂移速度加快 0.3%，未校正的 z 偏差為 200 cm × 0.003 = 6 mm，已是位置解析度的 8 倍，這說明為何漂移速度必須連續監測。數值為教學假設，不代表實驗的正式規格。~Drift-and-position exercise: assume the ALICE TPC runs at 400 V/cm with v_d = 2.58 cm/µs and a track produces a cluster 200 cm from the readout plane. Arrival time t = 200/2.58 ≈ 77.5 µs, i.e. 388 time bins at 5 MHz sampling. With D'_T = 220 µm/√cm the transverse diffusion is σ_T = 220×√200 ≈ 3.1 mm; a 7.5 mm pad row collects about 30 primary electrons, so the centroid statistical limit is 3.1/√30 ≈ 0.57 mm, and adding a pad-response-plus-noise term of 0.5 mm in quadrature gives about 0.76 mm, close to the measured 0.8 mm class. If a gas temperature rise speeds the drift by 0.3%, the uncorrected z error is 200 cm × 0.003 = 6 mm, eight times the position resolution, which is why drift velocity must be monitored continuously. Values are teaching assumptions, not the experiment's formal specification.
history: 時間投影室由 David Nygren 於 1974 年在勞倫斯柏克萊實驗室提出，首先用於 PEP-4 實驗；之後 ALEPH、STAR、ALICE 相繼採用。ALICE TPC 於 2008 年以多絲正比室讀出完工，2019–2021 年升級為四層 GEM 讀出，以支援 Run 3 的連續讀出與 50 kHz 鉛鉛碰撞率。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯，不涉及任何實驗的內部程序。~The time-projection chamber was proposed by David Nygren at Lawrence Berkeley Laboratory in 1974 and first used in the PEP-4 experiment; ALEPH, STAR and ALICE followed. The ALICE TPC was completed in 2008 with multiwire readout and upgraded in 2019–2021 to four-GEM readout for continuous operation at the 50 kHz Pb–Pb rate of Run 3. This course reconstructs public physics and engineering logic only, not any experiment's internal procedures.
